vetted.name: memory-gap-detection
vetted.already_exists: NONE in Clauderizer: cz_analyze returns 0 hits silently; the handoff ranker always renders top-k; corpus_health's never_surfaced is the INVERSE signal (lesson unused, not context uncovered). Nothing records 'memory had nothing to say here'. jcode's own version is a log line + UI event only — the doc's persisted MemoryGap for later extraction was never built — so the deterministic Clauderizer version EXCEEDS the source's implementation.
conditions: Advisory at the moment of the gap (L-68 clause 1): the cz_analyze result gains an explicit gap advisory when decisions+invariants are both empty for a decision-shaped probe — 'memory had nothing on this; if the area matters, record the decision/lesson now'. Tool results only, NEVER a digest line (INVARIANT-08 zero-bytes clause).

Persisted gap events carry NO raw probe text: telemetry line {kind: 'gap', surface, gameplan, phase, date, query_terms: count} only — the dream journal is the PII-linted channel for content; the gap event is a counter the dreamer/curator reads (D-069: journal consumed, not just written).
corpus_health gains a read-only gap_events count (zero renders nothing extra, the refusal_events precedent).

D-064 pre-named signal before any default claim: GAP CONVERSION — fraction of gap events followed within the same gameplan by a recorded decision/lesson whose text overlaps the gap's phase; plus gap-rate trend as the corpus matures. A discard is a successful outcome (L-50).
vetted.reasons: Kill case failed: (1) not already-exists (verified above); (2) deterministic and stdlib — no embedding needed, the trigger is the ranker's own empty result; (3) advisory-native, no flag, no block; (4) it closes a real observed loop — the dreamer currently learns what memory LACKED only when a human notices. Fractal-family precedent: D-069's 'every discipline gets a detector' applied to the corpus's own coverage.

vetted.name: reinforce-instead-of-duplicate
vetted.already_exists: PARTIAL: add_lesson's near-duplicate advisory (Jaccard >= _LESSON_DUP_JACCARD, INVARIANT-09) nudges consolidation, but the only verbs are consolidate-or-append — an agent that agrees 'this is the same lesson' has no blessed way to say 'strengthen the existing one'; the twin gets appended anyway and the curator proposes merging it later. jcode implements exactly this verb at storage level (cosine >= 0.85 -> reinforce, Vec<Reinforcement> breadcrumbs, strength count feeding retrieval score) — IMPLEMENTED there, load-bearing (memory.rs:394-467).
conditions: Never auto (INVARIANT-05): the write-time advisory OFFERS reinforce as a third verb beside consolidate/append; the agent decides. The engine translation is deterministic Jaccard via the canonical tokenizer — no cosine, no embedding (INVARIANT-09; any threshold change goes through the pre-registered-fixture process).

The reinforcement record is a compact TRACKED trailer on the existing lesson line — '*(reinforced xN, last <date>)*' updated in place through the blessed write and the single _inline_trailer renderer (grammar-tested vs lesson_state._STATE_RE, H-18 family) — because re-derivation evidence is team memory (D-067 tracked side), not machine-local telemetry. A telemetry 'reinforced' event rides along for lesson_health.

Strength is EVIDENCE, not authority: lesson_health/curator surface it (keep/promotion signal; also the inverse read — a lesson repeatedly re-derived instead of applied may be worded so it does not land); nothing ranks or deletes on it automatically (D-013/D-063).
D-064 pre-named signals: corpus growth rate and near-duplicate re-derivation rate per lesson before/after the verb exists; the H-26 lesson applies — measure TOKEN weight, not entry count.
vetted.reasons: Kill case failed: the defect is live in our corpus history (the P3-era curator found 6 obsoletion proposals re-deriving; H-26 measured consolidation-as-only-lever making handoffs HEAVIER). Reinforce is the missing cheaper verb: no new entry, no synthesis pass, evidence accrues on the survivor. jcode proves the verb carries its weight in production; our translation keeps judgment with the agent.

vetted.name: negative-space-closeout (what_i_did_not_check)
vetted.already_exists: PARTIAL: deferred-status honesty (D-070), unchecked exit criteria surfaced at transition, open items — all name KNOWN residue. Nothing asks the closing agent to declare the UNKNOWN residue: what was never looked at. jcode makes an empty what_i_did_not_check a hard validation error on swarm artifacts and calls it 'the cheat code: forcing an agent to list what it did not explore surfaces unexplored crannies' (SWARM_TASK_GRAPH.md:266-269, enforced at dag/ops.rs:724-728).
conditions: INVARIANT-05 translation: never a hard block. Three landing sites: (1) the clauderizer-fleet skill's worker-briefing contract REQUIRES completion reports to carry a 'What I did not check' section, with the HUB instructed to send back reports lacking it (coordinator judgment, not engine rejection) — lands with Phase 7's productization, both skill copies (L-55); (2) GAMEPLAN-PROCEDURE close-out and phase-summary guidance name the field; (3) the honest D-069 statement: the engine-side detector for it is DEFERRED and named as unenforced-on-discipline (L-68 clause 5) — a deterministic detector would need text classification the stdlib engine does not do.
Per D-064: adopt as discipline text now; whether it changes fleet outcome quality is a phase-5/phase-7 dogfood observation (worker reports with vs without the section), never asserted.
vetted.reasons: Kill case ALMOST succeeded on enforceability (no deterministic detector -> D-069 says unenforced discipline rots), survived on the fleet path: the hub reading worker reports IS the enforcement point that needs no engine code, and the field's value is highest exactly there (the gate/gap-injection loop it powers in jcode is the fleet-coordinator loop here).

Their session-resume-across-harnesses + .claude compatibility posture makes them structurally friendly to exactly our substrate.

design_notes_recorded_as_gameplan_lesson: Work-counters over wall-clock for perf/quality gates: 'a tight timing gate is a flaky gate, a flaky gate gets muted, which leaves no gate at all' — the decisive jcode gate asserts relayouts==0, a statement about WORK that generous slack cannot tune away.
The sabotage ritual as STANDING procedure: re-arm a gate (inject the violation, watch red, revert) whenever the gate changes in a way that could weaken it — L-68 step 4 made recurring, not one-time.

Advisory timing: defer repeatable advisories to a turn-end digest, collapse repeats, drop self-resolved ones — jcode measured the nag-on-every-write shape 'punishing the common healthy case'; mirrors why our advisories ride specific write results, and a design bound for any future recurring advisory.

direction_answer.build_in_this_direction: The vetted four land as a new phase in the 2.0 alpha (A-002); everything else is routed to the gameplan that owns it.
direction_answer.another_project_that_works_with_this: Two concrete lanes. NOW: jcode as a verified Clauderizer host (zero-code wiring via the compat surfaces, pending live verification). NEXT (candidate follow-on gameplan, not started): a memory bridge — jcode's per-user ambient memory and Clauderizer's tracked team memory are complementary by construction; jcode's own MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE open question #2 asks 'should some memories be shareable across a team?' — which is precisely Clauderizer's lane. A bridge would route jcode's extraction sideagent output through cz_* blessed writes (review-gated, PII boundary preserved) and/or feed the Clauderizer digest into jcode's memory graph as high-trust entries. Recorded as direction in D-075; needs its own gameplan with jcode-side experiments.
